To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the bump last scheme was successfully developed, and that the key process for the bump first scheme was identified.
the processes for thin 3D TSV WLCSP with bump last and bump first scheme have been developed and ready for mass production, and a yield of 100% and 99.66%, respectively, were achieved after de-bond.
the bump last scheme is ready for production and the bump first scheme is ready for the process development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of 3D WLP using via last TCV technology with low-temperature PECVD process.
the development of 3D WLP with via last TSV technology, which includes the processes of via formation, via cleaning and temporary bonding/de-bonding.
a novel 3D WLP technology with via last TSV and low temperature PECVD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the via last TSV technology for thin WLCSP can meet the requirement for high I/O density and small form factor.
the via last TSV process for the 3D WLP is ready for mass production.
the 8 inch, 100μm thin 3D TSV WLCSP using bump last scheme has been developed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bump last scheme is ready for production and the bump first scheme is under development.
the processes for thin WLCSP using bump first scheme were developed and ready for mass production.
the 3D WLP with via last TSV technology is ready for mass production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the oxide thickness at TSV bottom is critical for the de-bond process and the oxide etch and cleaning processes need to be optimized.
low-temperature PECVD process is critical to achieve the thin WLCSP package with TSVs and low-cost temporary bonding materials.
the via cleaning is a critical process for 3D WLP with TSV technology.
